prompt: Convert the callback-style API in this project to promises/async functions: `readRecord(id, cb)` in src/store.js, `loadUser(id, cb)` in src/users.js and `loadTeam(ids, cb)` in src/team.js must become `readRecord(id)`, `loadUser(id)` and `loadTeam(ids)` returning promises (no callback parameter). Errors must become rejections with the same Error messages; results must be the same values. loadTeam must still load users in parallel and keep the order of ids. Update the tests in test/ to the new API and run `node --test test/`.
